title: Golden Hour — A Walk With a Friend

creativeDirection.objective: Tell a warm, word-led but visually grounded miniature story about a man and his dog sharing an unhurried golden-hour walk.
creativeDirection.audience: General audience; viewers of gentle, everyday-life short films.
creativeDirection.concept: Follow the same man and dog through four connected outdoor environments—from a sunlit morning path, beside a river, into a quiet park and home at sunset—finding small moments of companionship along the way.

visualSystem.typography: Short editorial eyebrow, title and body lines integrated into each scene; no logos or captions beyond the authored copy.
visualSystem.composition: Full-frame painterly-vector landscapes with the man and dog kept together as a consistent foreground pair; warm open sky and negative space support restrained typography.
visualSystem.lighting: Soft morning blue and peach, cooler riverside reflections, a warm afternoon park, then a low amber sunset under a dusk-blue sky.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Layered vector hills, water, paths, trees, grass, sun haze and small dust/seed particles.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Slow camera drift and restrained push/pull moves over the four full-frame vector plates, with seeded atmospheric particle layers and soft cross-fade transitions. The man and dog are consistent illustrated motifs, not independently rigged or character-animated.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: A continuous original instrumental score with three restrained transition whooshes; no narration or dialogue.
assumptions: The man and dog are fictional illustrated characters, not portraits of real people.
The four SVG plates are original vector illustrations authored for this short.
The score and transition whoosh are reused original audio fixtures already in the repository.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: Use only original project artwork and project-generated audio; no external stock media or third-party branding.

renderStrategy.rationale: The short uses four full-frame 2D vector plates, per-layer camera transforms, titles, particles, transitions and global audio tracks—all capabilities already supported by the registered ProjectVideo composition.
requiredCapabilities: Four local SVG illustration layers with per-scene keyframed transforms
Four distinct environment palettes and backgrounds
Camera-style zoom/pan drift and cross-fade transitions
Editorial title/eyebrow/body overlays and seeded atmospheric particles
Continuous local score with three transition SFX cues
renderStrategy.fallback: Keep the dedicated four-scene ProjectVideo structure. Do not substitute a custom template or remove the planned audio; fix any unsupported property or report the blocker.

shots.purpose: Introduce the man, dog and warm start to their shared walk.
shots.visual: A painterly morning landscape with distant hills and a low golden sun. The man and dog stand together on a quiet path as the day opens.
shots.visualMethod: Full-frame original SVG illustration with layered camera movement.
shots.action: The camera slowly pushes through the illustrated morning landscape while the man and dog remain in their authored pose; dust particles provide the only independent foreground motion.
shots.visualProgression: Start: wide morning landscape and small figures. Development: a gentle push reveals the pair and the sunlit path. End: the path visually leads into the riverside scene.
shots.framing: Wide establishing composition with the man and dog near the centre-left and open sky on the upper right for editorial copy.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow push-in from 1.08 scale to 1.00 with a small lateral drift.
shots.transition: Soft fade into the riverside environment, with a restrained whoosh at the cut.
shots.onScreenText: A SMALL ADVENTURE / 01 — THE CITY WAKES — A familiar route. A new morning.
shots.audio: Continuous instrumental score; a quiet transition whoosh near the end.
shots.implementationNotes: Uses the first SVG plate, morning dust particle system, editorial text and the score bed.

shots.purpose: Shift the pace and show the walk becoming unhurried companionship.
shots.visual: The same pair follows a calm river path, with layered water, distant trees and cool blue reflections.
shots.visualMethod: Full-frame original SVG illustration with animated layer transforms and water glints.
shots.action: The camera drifts laterally across the static riverside illustration while the man and dog remain in their authored pose; small river-glint particles add atmosphere.
shots.visualProgression: Start: riverside and pair emerge from the fade. Development: water and distant banks slide gently past. End: a quiet grassy path leads into the park.
shots.framing: Medium-wide landscape with the pair low in the frame and the river stretching across the middle distance.
shots.cameraMovement: Subtle pan from left to right with a slow zoom from 1.05 to 1.00.
shots.transition: Soft cross-fade toward the park detail, punctuated by a short whoosh.
shots.onScreenText: FOLLOW THE WATER / 02 — TAKE THE LONG WAY — He slows down. The world does too.
shots.audio: Continuous instrumental score; a soft transition whoosh at the scene boundary.
shots.implementationNotes: Uses the riverside plate, river-glint particles, editorial text and the shared score/whoosh.

shots.purpose: Create a quiet observational pause where the dog can explore.
shots.visual: A more intimate park environment with a winding path, tree silhouettes and patches of warm light. The man and dog share the foreground.
shots.visualMethod: Full-frame original SVG illustration with a closer camera crop and drifting seed particles.
shots.action: The illustration holds the dog near the grass and the man waiting beside it; the camera eases closer while floating-seed particles move independently. Character limbs are not animated.
shots.visualProgression: Start: park path and figures are revealed. Development: the camera moves closer to the pair and the dog explores the grass. End: the light warms and the route carries the pair toward home.
shots.framing: Closer medium-wide composition with the pair more prominent and the path curving through the lower frame.
shots.cameraMovement: Gentle push-in from 1.12 to 1.00 with a small vertical drift.
shots.transition: Cross-fade to the sunset-home scene with one restrained whoosh.
shots.onScreenText: A PAUSE, NOT A PLAN / 03 — LET THEM SNIFF — A thousand stories in one patch of grass.
shots.audio: Continuous instrumental score; a subtle transition whoosh.
shots.implementationNotes: Uses the park-detail plate, floating-seed particles, editorial text and the same score/whoosh sources.

shots.purpose: Resolve the walk with a warm image of the man and dog returning home together.
shots.visual: A dusk-blue sky with a low warm sun, layered trees and the familiar pair moving home together along a quiet path.
shots.visualMethod: Full-frame original SVG illustration with sunset palette, camera drift and floating evening dust.
shots.action: The final illustration holds the pair together in the evening landscape; a slow camera pull-back and drifting dust provide a calm visual resolution.
shots.visualProgression: Start: warm sunset light and the returning pair. Development: the camera slowly pulls back and evening particles drift. End: the pair remains together in a calm final composition.
shots.framing: Wide closing image with the pair together in the lower middle and warm sky space above.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow pull-back from 1.07 scale with a gentle horizontal drift.
shots.transition: Fade the final image and editorial line gently toward black.
shots.onScreenText: THE BEST PART / 04 — HOME, TOGETHER — Some days are made of moments like this.
shots.audio: The instrumental score resolves and fades; no additional transition SFX after the final beat.
shots.implementationNotes: Uses the sunset plate, evening-dust particles, final editorial text and score fade.

acceptanceCriteria: The short tells one coherent four-location walk story and keeps the man and dog recognizable across all scenes.
Each of the four environments is visually distinct in palette, landscape and framing.
Camera drift, transitions and particles add restrained movement without obscuring the illustrations or text.
The authored editorial text is legible and correctly paired with its intended scene.
An original continuous score and three transition whooshes are present and mixed at restrained levels.
